town.text: The flame was given to us. We will be worthy of it, cold or warm.
town.direction: clear and measured; the pulpit voice

town.text: Come in out of the wind. There's soup at the back, and nobody counts the bowls.
Pray if you like. If you'd rather not, sit anyway. The chapel doesn't mind.
I buried two this week, old ones, cold in their beds. Pray it stays only the old.
Corvin says the records have holes in them. Corvin says a great many things.
Doubt is a draught under the door. Shut it, and keep the hearth.
Mind how you speak in the square. Fear spreads faster than fever.
I said the rites for everyone who died at the ford. All of them. The gods can sort out whose they were.
Goblin children came to my door asking what the bell is for. I had no idea what to tell them.
